notes: visual-qa-log.json (2026-07-27) verdict 'issues' with two high + one medium finding (375/393/900px) — all describe the SAME thing: the whole web sits behind a mandatory 'Logg på med Apple' gate, so no dashboard content renders for the unauthenticated screenshot harness. Unchanged ~6-day repeat of the 2026-07-21/22 findings.

Not code-fixable by this agent: the gate is a DELIBERATE owner decision (commit f905fc70a 'web: hele siden bak Sign in with Apple (eier-beslutning 21.07)'), documented inline in index.html:45-49. body.gated hiding all content until Sign in with Apple succeeds is the designed behaviour, not a rendering bug. Fixing it would mean REVERSING an explicit owner decision and auto-merging that reversal to the live site — outside mandate.

The AUTHENTICATION_FAILED error and the empty #apple-sign-in-button are — per visual-qa's own note — artifacts of the offline screenshot environment (no network to Apple CloudKit web services), where CloudKit JS never loads its own sign-in control. icloud-sync.js gate() fails gracefully to a calm error card telling the user to reload (index.html + gate-boot.js), never a blank page. Not a bug real signed-in users hit.

The medium 'no retry control on auth failure' finding: reload IS the documented retry, and visual-qa explicitly asks a HUMAN to confirm whether real users (e.g. Safari private browsing / blocked third-party cookies) hit this dead end. Any change to the auth flow cannot be screenshot-verified in this harness (the success path requires a live CloudKit sign-in the offline harness has no network for), so an auto-merging PR would ship an unverified change to the live sign-in — the prompt's exact 'abandon rather than ship anything you can't prove is clean' case.

The gate screen itself (wordmark, tagline, lead copy, error text) remains well laid out at all three widths — no overflow, clipping, or truncation, calm and centered. Nothing to fix there. Deferred to owner review — no PR opened, consistent with the 2026-07-21 and 2026-07-22 runs.
